summary: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, reporting the appointment of Justin Pettett as a non-executive, independent director effective April 1, 2026. The company entered into a Non-Executive Director's Agreement with Mr. Pettett, detailing standard compensation including an annual fee and expense reimbursement. No other arrangements or understandings led to his appointment. The filing frames the appointment as strengthening board capabilities amid the company's strategic initiatives and long-term growth plans. This is a routine director appointment disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. What to watch: any subsequent changes in strategic direction or board composition.
